result.summary: The page is mostly well rendered, but there is one layout defect in the "Fastest near you" carousel: the second card (Smash Bros Burgers) sits lower than the cards on either side of it, breaking the row's top alignment.

issues.description: In the "Fastest near you" carousel, the Smash Bros Burgers card is shifted about 28px lower than the Green Bowl Poké and Trattoria Piccolo cards. Its image starts lower, and its title and delivery fee text fall below the neighbouring cards' text baselines, so the row looks uneven.
issues.suggestion: Top-align all carousel cards (for example, align-items: flex-start on the row) and remove any stray top margin, padding or transform on the second card so that images, titles and delivery text share the same baselines.
